 Sonepur, District- Saran

Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. PUJA KUMARI D/O VINOD MAHTO R/O VILLAGE- BAISARBATI,
 P.S.- GALGALIA, DISTRICT- KISHANGANJ  ... ... Opposite Party/s

======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Rekha Prasad, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Sanjay Kumar Singh, APP  Mr.Raj Kumar, Adv.
 ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 15 12-11-2024 Heard the parties.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered under sections 341, 323, 354(C), 376,
498A, 506/34 of the IPC.

3. Allegation against the petitioner is of committing rape upon the informant and due to persuasion of public, he solemnized marriage with her but in the way, forcibly dropped her, for demand of Rs.5 Lac, in the form of dowry.
4.
Earlier the matter was sent to the mediation Center but mediation failed.
5. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is an innocent person and has committed no offence.

It is submitted that since the case has been lodged u/s 498-A IPC Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.67357 of 2022(15) dt.12-11-2024 as the informant is the wife of the petitioner,

sentences.text: so no offence u/s 376 IPC is made out against the petitioner.
Further, the petitioner is still ready to accept the informant as wife and is willing to live with her but the informant denied to live with the petitioner, during conciliation proceeding.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances and the fact that the informant is not ready to live with the petitioner, let the petitioner, named above, in the event of his arrest/surrender before the learned court below within a period of six weeks from today, be released on anticipatory bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below, where the case is pending/Successor court, in connection with Kishanganj (Mahila) P.S. Case No.42 of 2020, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) pallavi/-
